end_rhyme.chosen_from: NOT A DRAW — each sung section's own `schemes[fn].rgs` re-realised at the line ends, so this consumes no seed entropy and the placement draw above is untouched. Three counts, never summed (doctrine 79): `added` groups emitted; `blocked` blocks whose ends the placement draw had already spent; `narrow` blocks whose lines cannot carry one more DISTINCT word.

meter.chosen_from: 13390236392546005317973140 derived cycles (beats envelope [2, 200], slots envelope [1, 800]), measured BY DERIVATION ON THE DECLARED COORDINATE: 1 of 199 beats-per-line values, then 1 of 9 bars x subdivision factorisation(s) of 119 beats, then 1 of 3 groupings of 7. The line runs 119 beat(s) — at most 200, the longest line in characters, since a syllable is at least one character and a sung line carries at least one syllable a beat — and holds 119 slot(s). The pair share follows from how many ways each beat count factorises. Unit is notation, never enforced

narrative.chosen_from: uniform over the 11008 legal story line-ups of this shape (quality/narrative.py, M-121; the count is exact and the draw is entropy-last)

relations.chosen_from: NOT DRAWN — every group is judged against the whole vocabulary: every coarse relation and every registry schema; a pair satisfies a group when it stands in any of them

writer_brief:
Write a song: 16 lines, 6 sections, in this order:
  [VERSE — 4 lines — 68 bars of 7/8, one-beat pickup]
      up to 118 syllables a line after the pickup
  [DROP — 2 lines — 34 bars of 7/8, one-beat pickup]
      up to 118 syllables a line after the pickup
  [CHORUS — 3 lines — 51 bars of 7/8, one-beat pickup]
      up to 118 syllables a line after the pickup
  [PRECHORUS — 2 lines — 34 bars of 7/8, one-beat pickup]
      up to 118 syllables a line after the pickup
  [CHORUS — 3 lines — 51 bars of 7/8, one-beat pickup]
      up to 118 syllables a line after the pickup
  [CODA — 2 lines — 34 bars of 7/8]
      up to 119 syllables a line after the pickup
Feel: 7/8 grouped 2+2+3.
Rhyme plan (line numbers over the whole song):
  lines 2 & 3 & 4 must stand in at least one relation — any coarse relation (rhyme, rime riche, assonance, consonance) or any registry schema
  lines 5 & 6 must stand in at least one relation — any coarse relation (rhyme, rime riche, assonance, consonance) or any registry schema
  lines 7 & 8 must stand in at least one relation — any coarse relation (rhyme, rime riche, assonance, consonance) or any registry schema
  lines 10 & 11 must stand in at least one relation — any coarse relation (rhyme, rime riche, assonance, consonance) or any registry schema
  lines 15 & 16 must stand in at least one relation — any coarse relation (rhyme, rime riche, assonance, consonance) or any registry schema
Story plan (one job per sung section; each enters from the section before it as stated):
  VERSE1 puts the world and its cast in place
  DROP1 is the fixed claim the song keeps returning to — because of VERSE1
  CHORUS1 is the fixed claim the song keeps returning to — against DROP1
  PRECHORUS1 lets the pressure in — after CHORUS1
  CHORUS2 is the fixed claim the song keeps returning to — against PRECHORUS1
  CODA1 cashes the standing pressure — set beside (connection unstated) CHORUS2
Every chorus after the first repeats the first chorus word for word, line for line.
Line 7 is the hook — make it the line someone leaves humming.
